name: Ling-3.0-flash
archDisplay: Hybrid-linear MoE: 35 KDA + 7 Gated MLA layers (5:1), 2 dense layers, 512 routed / 1 shared / 8 active experts, hidden 2560
note: inclusionAI's Ling 3.0 mid-tier, launched 2026-07-24 and open-sourced on Hugging Face under MIT on 2026-08-02. It is a 124B-total / 5.1B-active hybrid-linear MoE with a native 256K context (extendable to 1M) and thinking on by default but switchable. Ant says it matches or beats its predecessor Ring-2.6-1T on key benchmarks, but its comparison charts are images only, so no table values can be transcribed. The one text-stated figure is MiniAppBench 25.3% (in-house), which has no catalog slug.
